name: Large Cherry Blossom Survival House
description: A large cherry blossom survival house in pink blocks with a steep gray roof, a tall tower and a covered porch. Two floors, a balcony and flower beds along the walls. Cherry wood and bricks do most of the work. Suits a cherry grove or a pink-themed base.
